objective: Define and implement cross-layer verification covering full-stack financial journey tests (frontend → API → service → DB → response → render)
overview: Cross-layer verification ensures end-to-end correctness of financial data flows across frontend hooks, API routes, services, repositories, and database layers. This validates that Zod schema validation, DTO transformations, and API contracts are consistent throughout the stack.

critical_journeys: Account management: hook → API → account_service → account_repository → DB
Card display: hook → API → card_service → DB
Loan management: hook → API → loan_service → loan_repository → DB
Cashflow aggregation: hook → API → cashflow_service → DB
Dashboard metrics: hook → API → dashboard_service → cashflow_service → account_repository → DB
Reconciliation scan: hook → API → reconciliation_service → DB

missing: Full-stack journey tests that validate complete data flow from frontend hooks to DB
Schema consistency tests between backend DTOs and frontend Zod schemas
Round-trip validation tests (frontend → API → backend → API → frontend)
End-to-end financial calculation tests across all layers
gap_analysis.priority: High - without cross-layer tests, schema drift between layers goes undetected

verification_criteria.validation: Zod schema validates response at frontend layer
All paise calculations consistent across layers

test_additions_required.coverage: Full account CRUD journey with schema validation
Loan lifecycle with schedule and prepayment

success_criteria: All 5 critical journeys have end-to-end tests
Schema validation tested at both frontend (Zod) and backend (Pydantic) layers
API contract tests validate response shapes match across layers
Financial calculations verified to be consistent from DB to UI
Error propagation tested across all layers
